common.languageLabel.notes: Accessible label of the language switch on every Arabic customer page.

common.switchToEnglish.notes: Language switch link label: the language's own name, kept in Latin script on purpose.

common.currencySAR.notes: Currency symbol shown after the number, e.g. 150.00 ر.س (glossary D8, same as the website).

common.continueToWhatsApp.notes: The one big button on the referral and Instagram landing pages.

common.error.body.en: Please try again in a moment.
common.error.body.ar: يرجى المحاولة مرة أخرى بعد قليل.

common.unavailable.title.notes: Arabic pages only: shown when the business WhatsApp number cannot be resolved (the English page shows its generic not-found text).

common.unavailable.body.en: We couldn't open WhatsApp right now. Please try again shortly.
common.unavailable.body.ar: تعذّر فتح واتساب حالياً. يرجى المحاولة بعد قليل.

pay.paid.heading.notes: Used for both the page title and the heading, like the English page.

pay.paid.body.en: This order has already been paid. You can return to WhatsApp.
pay.paid.body.ar: تم دفع هذا الطلب مسبقاً. يمكنك العودة إلى واتساب.

pay.checkout.heading.notes: Used for both the page title and the heading, like the English page.

pay.checkout.subtitle.notes: {currency} is the Arabic currency name for SAR (pay.currencyName.SAR) and the 3-letter code for any other currency.

pay.service.notes: Arabic page only: service bookings also show what is being paid for.

pay.slot.notes: {date} is YYYY-MM-DD and {time} is HH:mm, both Western digits.

pay.payButton.notes: {amount} is the formatted total, e.g. 150.00 ر.س.

pay.failedFallback.ar: تعذّر إتمام الدفع. يرجى المحاولة مرة أخرى.
pay.failedFallback.notes: Shown when Stripe returns no error text of its own.

pay.successMessage.en: ✅ Payment successful! You can return to WhatsApp now.
pay.successMessage.ar: ✅ تم الدفع بنجاح! يمكنك العودة إلى واتساب الآن.

pay.success.body.en: You can return to WhatsApp now.

pay.failed.body.en: Your payment wasn't completed. You can try again or cancel.
pay.failed.body.ar: لم تكتمل عملية الدفع. يمكنك المحاولة مرة أخرى أو الإلغاء.

pay.cancelled.body.en: Return to WhatsApp to keep shopping.

pay.cancelledWhatsApp.en: No worries! Your cart has been cleared. Feel free to browse again anytime. 🛍️
pay.cancelledWhatsApp.ar: لا بأس! تم تفريغ سلتك. يمكنك التصفح من جديد في أي وقت. 🛍️
pay.cancelledWhatsApp.notes: Reference copy only. The English cancelled page also sends this as a WhatsApp text and clears the cart; the Arabic cancelled page deliberately does neither, so nothing renders this string yet.

referral.invitedBusiness.en: You've been invited to claim this offer from {business}.
referral.invitedBusiness.ar: تمت دعوتك للاستفادة من هذا العرض من {business}.
referral.invitedBusiness.notes: {business} is the merchant's business name. The page deliberately never shows anything about the customer who shared the link (no name, no phone): the link is public.

referral.invitedGeneric.en: You've been invited to claim this offer.
referral.invitedGeneric.ar: تمت دعوتك للاستفادة من هذا العرض.
referral.invitedGeneric.notes: Used when the merchant's business name is not available. Never mentions who shared the link.

referral.reward.notes: {reward} is the merchant-written reward text of the promotion (e.g. "Free dessert"); the line is omitted when there is none.

referral.explain.en: Tap the button below to open WhatsApp with a ready-made message and claim your offer.
referral.explain.ar: اضغط الزر أدناه لفتح واتساب برسالة جاهزة والاستفادة من عرضك.

referral.prefill.en: Hi, I'd like to claim my referral offer.
referral.prefill.ar: مرحباً، أرغب في الاستفادة من عرض الإحالة الخاص بي.
referral.prefill.notes: Prefilled WhatsApp text. The code appends a new line with the Latin token `Code: <CODE>` after it; that token must stay Latin because the inbound referral-code detection matches it.

referral.notFound.body.en: This referral link is invalid, expired, or no longer active.
referral.notFound.body.ar: رابط الإحالة هذا غير صالح أو منتهي الصلاحية أو لم يعد نشطاً.

instagram.explain.en: Tap the button below to open WhatsApp with a ready-made message and claim this offer.
instagram.explain.ar: اضغط الزر أدناه لفتح واتساب برسالة جاهزة والاستفادة من هذا العرض.

instagram.prefill.en: Hi, I'd like to claim the {name} offer.
instagram.prefill.ar: مرحباً، أرغب في الاستفادة من عرض «{name}».
instagram.prefill.notes: Prefilled WhatsApp text; {name} is the promotion name. The code appends a new line with the Latin token `Code: IG-XXXXXXXX` after it; that token must stay Latin because the inbound tracking-code detection matches it.

instagram.prefillGeneric.en: Hi, I'd like to claim this offer.
instagram.prefillGeneric.ar: مرحباً، أرغب في الاستفادة من هذا العرض.
instagram.prefillGeneric.notes: Used when the promotion has no usable name.

instagram.notFound.body.en: This link is invalid or no longer active.
instagram.notFound.body.ar: هذا الرابط غير صالح أو لم يعد نشطاً.
